android-main-capability.description: Gate R0.7 — minimal capability set for the Interest Growth Android runtime. Android never inherits the desktop surface: no window state, no desktop shell/window controls, no desktop filesystem breadth, no dialog save permissions, no updater, and no provider-secret administration. The remote broker and SAF operations are custom commands (remote_*, remote_pick_document, remote_api_upload_by_uri, remote_save_export) that do not require plugin capabilities, so the only plugin surface is opening external URLs in the system browser.

main-capability.description: Minimal capability set for the Interest Growth main desktop window. Explicitly scoped to desktop platforms (Gate R0.7) so window state, desktop shell controls, desktop filesystem and dialog permissions never leak into the Android build; the Android runtime has its own minimal capability (android.json).
